item.title: Lou Holtz, Catholic college football staple who coached Notre Dame to 1988 national title, dies at 89
item.description: Lou Holtz, the pint-sized motivator who restored greatness at Notre Dame and demanded it everywhere else he went, died in Orlando, Florida, Notre Dame announced Wednesday. He was 89.

item.title: Man pleads guilty to bringing explosives to a DC Catholic church marking the start of a Supreme Court term
item.description: A New Jersey man pleaded guilty Thursday to charges that he brought dozens of homemade explosive devices to a Washington, D.C., church that was preparing for an annual Mass celebrating the start of the Supreme Court’s term, court records show.

item.title: Bishop says Pope’s visit to show Christianity ‘an asset to Algeria’
item.description: As Pope Leo XVI prepares to visit Algeria, the Bishop Michel Jean-Paul Guillaud of Constantine says the Holy Father’s presence will demonstrate that Christianity “is an asset and not a danger” to Algeria.

item.title: In war-torn Lebanon, a Filipino Jesuit stands with abandoned migrants
item.description: In war-torn Lebanon, a Filipino Jesuit stands with abandoned migrants.

item.title: For survivors, Rhode Island clergy abuse report brings vindication and renewed demands
item.description: The sound of the school nurse’s office door opening. Light reflecting off a stained-glass window. Tearful outbursts and fear of getting on the school bus. For many survivors of clergy abuse, memories like these linger for decades.

item.title: Christian villagers in India uneasy after church vandalized
item.description: The cost of the damage is estimated to be ₹850,000 – or $9,250 – a gargantuan sum for the poor villagers who work for daily wages, mostly on local farms.

item.title: Pope issues fresh appeal for peace as Middle East conflict escalates
item.description: “From Iran and from the whole Middle East," Leo said, "news continues to reach us that gives rise to profound consternation."

item.title: Pope names veteran Vatican diplomat as ambassador to the US to manage relations with Trump
item.description: 68-year-old Archbishop Gabriele Caccia inherits a complicated and consequential dossier on both the U.S. Church and state fronts at a time of global turmoil.

item.title: Cardinal denounces Trump administration’s ‘gamifying’ of Iran conflict
item.description: “The moral crisis we are facing is not just a matter of the war itself,” Cupich said, “but also how we, the observers, view violence, for war now has become a spectator sport or strategy game.”

item.title: Pope Leo XIV decries violence against women, appeals for respect of equal dignity
item.description: Pope Leo XIV gave a shout-out to women everywhere and called for an end to feminicide and gender-based violence on Sunday, International Women’s Day.
